cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Rank Everything
cards.instruction: Turn every new contribution into a ranking that places you nearer the top.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. For the project report, my printer troubleshooting ranks above your restart suggestion. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The restart got everyone's invoices printed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Implementation: second place. Identifying the blockage stays first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your hundred-page lunch menu was the blockage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then move my stress testing above troubleshooting. Your restart is third.

mechanism: A manages a report ranking by converting B success and A fault into new categories above B while granting presentation control to keep B cooperating.
confusable: Unlike excuse-making alone, each fact is explicitly placed in an ordered hierarchy; confidence depends on B willingness to carry that ordered account.
comparison: Report category order and attribution differ from a picnic cake-serving hierarchy.
seedUse: Use D67-b restart/invoices/menu/blockage/stress-testing with S02-a claiming B-driven revisions as a planned ordering.
